data.title: Update fleece prime with full dependency management instructions
data.description: The `fleece prime` and `fleece prime hierarchy` commands should be updated to include instructions on how to use the `fleece dependency` command to manage a tree of issues. Note that the fleece CLI version that is currently installed is out of date, run `dotnet tool update -g Fleece.Cli` to update to the latest version before inspecting these commands, or just review the codebase.
